store.name: Tide & Clay
store.tagline: Slow mornings, wet clay, salt air
store.about: Your photos keep coming back to the wheel, the first coffee of the day and the walk along the water. This collection keeps those textures close: thrown-clay curves, sea-worn colour and the quiet of a weekend market.

products.title: Thrown Rim Band
products.prompt: Ring in sterling silver, 4 mm wide band with a softly uneven, hand-thrown rim profile like the lip of a stoneware bowl, satin finish outside and high polish inside, no stones, comfort fit.
products.why: Hand-thrown ceramics show up in 41% of your moments, more than any other idea.

products.title: Pour-Over Drop
products.prompt: Pendant necklace in brass, a small 18 mm cone-shaped drop with fine concentric ridges, brushed finish, on a 45 cm fine cable chain, no stones.
products.why: A morning coffee ritual runs through 37% of your moments.

products.title: Tide Pool Studs
products.prompt: Earrings in sterling silver, a pair of 9 mm organic pebble-shaped studs with a gently rippled surface like water over rock, oxidised recesses and polished highs, no stones.
products.why: Coastal walks appear in 29% of your moments.

products.title: Kiln Stripe Rug
products.prompt: Rug, hand-tufted wool, 5x8 ft, wide irregular horizontal bands in oat and clay with a thin charcoal line between them, slightly wavering edges like glaze drips, low even pile.
products.why: Built from the colours you live with, for the studio and workshop settings that fill 38% of your moments.

products.title: Pressed Petal Pillow
products.prompt: Throw pillow, 18x18 in linen-look woven cover, a loose scattered pattern of small pressed-flower silhouettes in dusty rose and sea glass on an oat ground, soft matte print.
products.why: Dried flowers turn up in 18% of your moments, and linen and natural textures in 14%.

products.title: Market Morning Print
products.prompt: Wall art print, 12x16 in matte paper, an abstract grid of soft-edged rectangles like market stall awnings seen from above, in sea glass, oat, clay and charcoal, generous margins, no text.
products.why: Slow weekend markets show up in 16% of your moments.
